turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: Revenue for September 2026 was EUR 12,582.75 for 1 to 30 September 2026, with cancelled orders left out and each order counted on its UTC order date, because the semantic layer buckets days in UTC and has no Amsterdam-day option, so this is not the Amsterdam-day figure you asked for. Freshness: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
